profile.Name: Cannibal Hunter Robun
profile.Personality: A tough mercenary who does not tolerate thieves or intruders.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Cannibal Hunters from the Bastion, where Darkfinger meets Sinkuun, and hires out their swords against cannibals. He is the younger brother of the writer of the Captive's Journal.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Gruff warnings to leave, then force.
